meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full, ultra and the wenyan variants. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 AI 回复像电报一样精简,省时省钱。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果更想看要点、不想花时间读长回答。
copy.tagline_en: Make AI reply like a telegram: short, fast, cost-saving.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer brief answers and want to skip verbose AI responses.

howto.what: Claude会改用极简的“穴居人”口吻回复，只留技术实质，删掉冠词、客套与装饰。默认档位是full，且全程保持到你说停止；另有lite、ultra和文言文变体可切换。
howto.when: 当你说“caveman mode”“be brief”等关键词，或用“/caveman”命令时触发；模式会一直保持，直到你说“stop caveman”或“normal mode”才恢复。

say.note: 进入默认 full 档，全会话生效
切换 ultra 档，回复更极简
改用文言文风格的压缩档

howto.what_en: Claude switches to terse 'smart caveman' replies, keeping technical substance while dropping articles, pleasantries, and decorative fluff. Default level: full, persistent until stop. Levels: lite/ultra/wenyan variants.
howto.when_en: Triggered by saying things like 'caveman mode', 'be brief', 'less tokens', or using '/caveman'. Stays active until 'stop caveman' or 'normal mode'.
